crossRefs.note: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

parallels.note: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

people.name: Jehoram
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
translations.kjv: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
